title: Great private tour in Granada
text: We did the Flamenco and Tapas in Granada, Spain with Mario. Mario met us promptly at Plaza Nuevo and asked if we'd like to the location or take a shuttle. We chose to walk. Along the way Mario spoke of the origans of Flamenco and what we were about to see. The show was in a cave and about 50 minutes long. I cannot say I would ever see another one, but it was definitely a unique experience. We then toured the neighborhood that Mario was very familiar with as he lived there. author: Safari08771633087

title: Best tour & guide
text: Had so much fun with Ignacio on our Flamenco and tapas tour of Granada. He made our excursion so memorable with his wit and humor. Ignacio made us so comfortable and went out of his way to show us highlights of this incredible city.  Highly recommend this tour with Ignacio the show was fantastic the tapas were delicious but the best part of the tour was Ignacio.
author: U3995ETkarenb

title: A must-do tour
text: I’ve been in Granada a few times and this experience was really the best! Meri showed our group places I’ve never seen, took us to local bars for tapas and drinks and the flamenco experience was exceptional. Meri taught our group so much about the Albaicin and Sacromonte. We all loved this tour.
author: Victoria_M

title: Tapas and Flamenco, WOW!!
text: Our guide Ignacio was wonderful! He knew all the great tapas spots and the flamenco show was outstanding. We ended the evening with some of the best ice cream we’ve ever had!
author: Trip799593

title: Intimate experience coordinated by Not Just a Tourist!
text: We worked with Mahsa to coordinate our various private tours in Granada and Seville, and could not be happier! In Granada, we did the market tour with Ramon and the flamenco tour with Ignacio. In Sevilla, we did the walking tour and the Triana tapas tour with Guille, and the catedral tour with Sara. Every one of the guides that we worked with was very professional, and provided with very intimate and personal experience. I was travelling with my parents (in the late 60s and 70s) and my husband. We all had lots of fun on these tours. We highly recommend working with Not Just a Tourist!
author: Voyager37111107767

title: Spectacular
text: Amazing and very unique experience. Predrag was an amazing host. Showed us parts of town we would have never seen and was generally a very pleasant person to be around. The Flamengo show was spectacular to say the least. Amazing
author: Bogdan_S

title: Not to be missed.
text: An amazing night with our guide Jose. Don’t go on this tour without him. He has an intimate knowledge of the city and its history. The flamenco performance was outstanding. Not to be missed.
author: Helen_C

title: Best tour in Granada and our whole trip. Lovely experience, the food was great and the flamenco show was really nice.
text: The tapas trail was lovable. The food was great. Jose Manuel our guide was lovable, well knowledgeable and nice to talk to. He gave us an authentic experience as he knows the people. He was able to provide better options than promised since some of the items were closed due to the Covid-19 and the curfew times. The the flamenco show was lovely. we even had the opportunity to take pictures with the dancers who were really provided lovely entertainment. It was the best tour we took in Granada.
author: Bassem_Z

title: Great Flamengo show
text: Gypsy flamego show was fabulous as well as tour of Sacramonte.  The only reason I rate a 4 rather than 5 is that the tapas tour needs to be more organized with reservations ahead of time so that seating can be secured.  Many bars were  crowded  with no seating.
author: Marco_G

title: Experience true flamenco once in your life
